question: What should the canonical model-safety workflow be for staging, verifying, promoting, and rolling back model changes?
rationale: The missing behavior is clear, but the command UX and persistence/probe contracts affect provider routing, auth profiles, fallback ordering, and related diagnostic features.

options.title: Design unified migration workflow
options.body: Specify one `openclaw models` flow that owns staging, verification, promotion, old-primary preservation, rollback state, and interaction with fallback-chain and all-model probes.

options.title: Split into narrower diagnostics first
options.body: Keep this issue open as the staged-migration tracker while separately landing fallback-chain and all-configured-model probes before promotion/rollback UX.

options.title: Defer staged migration
options.body: Keep current immediate-set and manual-fallback primitives, documenting manual safer rollout steps until maintainers want a broader model migration contract.

recommendation.title: Design unified migration workflow
recommendation.body: Specify one `openclaw models` flow that owns staging, verification, promotion, old-primary preservation, rollback state, and interaction with fallback-chain and all-model probes.

likelyOwner.reason: He already provided keep-open guidance and has the strongest combined history in the model CLI, fallback, and status/probe surfaces.
